tasks.label: hotel: ensure server
args: $health = $null; try { $health = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:3001/health' -TimeoutSec 2 } catch {}; if ($health.status -eq 'ok') { Write-Output 'Hotel management app is running at http://localhost:3001'; exit 0 }; $env:PATH = 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\MSBuild\Microsoft\VisualStudio\NodeJs;' + $env:PATH; npm run dev

background.endsPattern: .*Hotel management app is running at http://localhost:3001.*
